games.name: [QOL] Left 4 Blox
games.desc:
[L4B]

"Left 4 Blox" is a chaotic versus zombie game featuring a variety of unique gamemodes, weapons, perks & maps. As a Survivor, your goal is to work together with your team and stay alive until the timer runs out; survival is your only path to victory. As an infected, your objective is to hunt down and eliminate all survivors before time runs out.

Game Keybinds for PC and Console can be found in-game settings; as well offering a support for you to customize them however you want.
For Mobile users you can as well customize them by choosing the size and where you want them to be.
You can find the options in: Settings > UI

Vote-Kick Command:
/votekick PlayerName, Reason (exploit, afk)
- There's requirements you have to met in order to use this feature.

This project is fully and heavily inspired by Left 4 Dead 2, a game developed by Valve.
We are still progressing in the game development since it's not fully finished. Expect bugs to happen, any bug report sent will be appreciated.
